name: Utilities account setup (category guide)
summary: SP Group power-water open/transfer for foreigners — Singpass, deposits, meter photos, and why the landlord keeping the account is not always wrong.
body: Many condo TAs leave utilities in the landlord’s name and recharge you; HDB and some landlords push tenants to open an SP Group account. Foreigners can open accounts online with Singpass once FIN/MyInfo is live — IPA-only attempts stall. Expect a security deposit (forum quotes around a few hundred SGD) and a calendar appointment for some premises; newer developments may auto-transfer. Photograph meter readings at key collection regardless of whose name is on the bill. Town gas / bottled gas and fibre are separate vendors from SP electricity-water — do not assume one call opens everything. Pair with the telco category guide for SIM→Singpass sequencing and the utilities-telecom guide for the week-one stack. This is a category guide, not a reseller ranking.
whenToEngage: Need SP account on FIN / Singpass after move-in
Landlord agent unsure about foreigner open-account path

Meter photos needed whether or not you take the account
